findings.default_vs_best: the configured default (Monthly) did NOT have the lowest mean pushdown latency; Quarterly did (3.293ms vs 3.738ms)
findings.speedup_explanation: From the coarsest (Quarterly, 80 chunks) to the finest (Weekly, 1,010 chunks) granularity, mean row-wise baseline latency goes from 74.141ms to 298.751ms and mean pushdown latency from 3.293ms to 7.136ms. The speedup ratio mixes both movements: a baseline that slows with chunk count inflates it without any pushdown improvement, so the ratio alone is not evidence that a granularity is better for pushdown.
